data.body: **[P1] Keep the execution region synchronized with endpoint updates.** `/lambda-endpoint` accepts a new `RegionName`, but only updates `LambdaInvoker`; subsequent executions are still stamped with the startup region here. Their handlers use the new region, while full-ARN chained invokes in that region are rejected as cross-region and execution details report the old region. Update the executor's default region alongside the endpoint, preserve it per execution, and build response ARNs from `execution.region`.
